name: Operation 1 Code
definition: Indicates the relationship between two variables.

TILL.name: Till
TILL.definition: Indicates a range delimited by two variables.

ORRR.name: Or
ORRR.definition: Indicates either of two variables is valid, but not both.

ANDD.name: And
ANDD.definition: Indicates that only when both variables are given, the operation is valid.
